instance.name: release-provenance
instance.title: Release provenance
instance.description: A software release pipeline that signs what it builds and admits to production only what it can prove.

packs.name: generic
packs.title: Model integrity
packs.description: References resolve, everything has an owner, and contracts connect a producer to a consumer.

rules.title: Every reference resolves
rules.why: A dangling id means a diagram or plan points at something that does not exist.

rules.title: Every element has an owner team
rules.why: Unowned parts of a system are where fixes stall.

rules.title: Contracts have a producer and a consumer
rules.why: A contract nobody reads is a promise nobody checks.

rules.title: Carried contracts connect producer to consumer
rules.why: A relationship that carries a contract should join someone who makes it to someone who uses it.

rules.title: Views name existing elements
rules.why: A view that names a missing element silently drops it from the picture.

packs.name: plan
packs.title: Plan soundness
packs.description: Every capability the plan needs is provided, in an order that can actually run.

rules.title: Every required capability is provided
rules.why: A unit waiting on a capability nobody builds can never start.

rules.title: No dependency cycles
rules.why: A cycle means none of its units can go first.

rules.title: Every phase has an exit test
rules.why: Without a checkable exit, a phase ends when someone gets tired of it.

rules.title: Fidelity moves go up the ladder
rules.why: A unit should leave an element more real than it found it.

rules.title: Unit owners exist
rules.why: Work assigned to a team that does not exist is unassigned work.

rules.title: Earlier phases do not wait on later ones
rules.why: If phase one needs something phase two builds, the phases are in the wrong order.

packs.name: flow
packs.title: Value stream
packs.description: Handoffs, queues and waiting time along the paths work takes.

rules.title: Paths stay under the handoff limit
rules.why: Each handoff between teams adds waiting and loses context.

rules.title: Queues declare a WIP limit
rules.why: A queue with no limit grows until someone notices.

rules.title: Person steps declare wait time
rules.why: Lead time is mostly waiting; if it is not recorded it cannot be summed.

phases.name: Build provenance
phases.exit_test: Every artifact in the store has a signed provenance attestation that a reviewer can verify from the digest alone.

phases.name: Enforce at deploy
phases.exit_test: Production admits only artifacts whose attestations pass policy, and every denial is logged with its reason.

units.title: Pin dependencies through the mirror
units.check: A build with the public registry blocked at the firewall still succeeds, and the provenance verifier ran on every package.

units.title: Generate an SBOM for every build
units.check: The last ten builds each have an SBOM attestation keyed by image digest.

units.title: Stand up the attestation store
units.check: An attestation written by CI can be read back by digest from a production node.

units.title: Sign artifacts with a managed key
units.check: A new artifact verifies against the published public key, and the private key cannot be exported.

units.title: Emit build provenance from CI
units.check: Every build on the main branch writes a signed provenance attestation naming source commit and runner.

units.title: Agree on the provenance format
units.check: Platform, security and release have signed off one format document, and it is linked from the repository.

units.title: Scan images and record results
units.check: Each image in the store has a scan attestation no older than 24 hours.

units.title: Measure unsigned artifacts in the store
units.check: A weekly count of unsigned artifacts by team is published, with last week's number beside it.

units.title: Write the admission policy
units.check: The policy denies a test artifact with no provenance and admits one with valid provenance and SBOM.

units.title: Run policy in audit-only mode
units.check: Two weeks of production deploys evaluated with zero blocked deploys and every would-deny recorded.

units.title: Log every policy decision
units.check: Each admission request has exactly one audit record with the decision and its reasons.

units.title: Agree the enforcement date with release
units.check: A dated enforcement plan is approved by release and security, with the exception process named.

units.title: Turn on enforcement in production
units.check: An unsigned test artifact is denied in production and the denial appears in the audit log.

units.title: Route policy denials to on-call
units.check: A production denial pages on-call within five minutes with the artifact digest and the failing rule.

units.title: Measure deploy lead time before and after
units.check: Median merge-to-production time for the month before and after enforcement is published side by side.

findings.message: Public package registry has no owner team.
Provenance verifier has no owner team.
Contract policy-decision has a producer but no consumer.
Unit u14 requires exception-workflow, which no unit provides.
Unit u08 (Build provenance) depends on decision-log, which is only provided in Enforce at deploy.
Queue Alert queue does not declare attrs.wip_limit.
Person step On-call engineer does not declare attrs.wait_days, so lead time cannot be summed.
The path from Source repository to Engineer crosses 5 team handoffs; the limit is 4.

patches.title: Verify provenance at the mirror
patches.why: Pinning dependencies stops surprise upgrades but not a poisoned upstream. Checking upstream provenance before a package enters the mirror closes that gap.

set.check: A build with the public registry blocked at the firewall still succeeds, and the provenance verifier ran on every package.

findingsIntroduced.message: Provenance verifier has no owner team.

patches.title: Retire the build cache and give policy decisions a reader
patches.why: The shared cache lets one build poison another, and nothing reads policy decisions today. Removing the cache trades build time for isolation; the audit log becomes the decision reader.

cascade.because: its element moves named removed element cache

findingsResolved.message: Contract policy-decision has a producer but no consumer.
